## Gestures: how the hand maps onto each variable

*Pedagogical control laws — how a gesture explores the physics. None of them is a physical law; changing one changes the teaching, not the science.*

| control | gesture | mapping (control law) | metaphor, stated |
|---|---|---|---|
| INT-PROBE-001 | trace | the probe stays under the hand along the beam (the beam's own scale on screen); the hand finds the beam within 28 px of it; moving the probe 30 px counts as discovered; an arrow key moves it 0.25 Mpc/h | — |
| INT-VIEW-001 | drag | a sideways drag turns the view by 0.004 per px, a vertical drag tilts it by 0.004 per px | — |
| INT-ATOMV-001 | drag | the arrow's tip stays under the hand — 2.2 px per km/s; an arrow key moves it by 1 km/s | pushing the atom by hand is a way to explore other speeds along the beam; it does not claim that touching an atom moves it |
| INT-TEMP-001 | hold | holding still raises log10 T by 0.3 dex per second; moving vertically while holding (after 6 px) changes log10 T by 0.008 dex per px, down cooler; an arrow key multiplies T by 1.12 | "hold the gas to explore warmer gas" — holding is how the reader explores warmer gas; it does not claim that touching gas heats it (the forest's gas is heated by the ultraviolet background), and releasing keeps the state reached — no cooling physics is invented |
| INT-THERM-BIN-001 | dwell | the 2.5 km/s bin under the pointer (a tap pins it); dwelling 0.6 s counts as discovered | — |
| INT-LIGHT-001 | drag | the light stays under the hand where it was grabbed; its comoving distance is proportional to its position along the path | — |
| INT-STRUCT-001 | tap | the structure (or its shadow) under the pointer is followed | — |
| INT-SQUEEZE-001 | squeeze | the grabbed point stays under the hand — the spectrum is compressed about 0 Å by the ratio of the hand's position to where it grabbed; with "show the physics" the squeeze settles onto a named frame within 7 px of it (none in review probes) | the squeeze is the frame change itself — every intermediate state is a named frame, "the rest frame of gas at z", stated on the ruler |
| INT-PLACE-001 | drag | the gas stays under the hand along the real-space axis (the axis's own scale); a press becomes a move once the hand travels 6 px sideways before it travels up or down; an arrow key moves it 0.05 Mpc/h | moving the parcel by hand asks "what if this gas were farther away?" — it keeps its own amount, temperature and motion (no density evolution, no new surroundings); only its place, and so its recession from the expansion, changes |
| INT-PUSH-001 | drag | the arrow's tip stays under the hand — 0.45 px per km/s; an arrow key moves it by 5 km/s | moving the gas's motion by hand is a way to explore other velocities; the toy's own velocities are restored with one quiet action, and a faint band shows the range it actually has |
| INT-WARM-001 | hold | holding still raises log10 T by 0.3 dex per second; moving vertically while holding (after 6 px) changes log10 T by 0.008 dex per px, down cooler; an arrow key multiplies T by 1.12; on this parcel, which can also be moved, warming begins after 0.25 s held still, and a sideways movement first turns the press into a move (T stays exactly where it was) | "hold the gas to explore warmer gas" — holding is how the reader explores warmer gas; it does not claim that touching gas heats it (the forest's gas is heated by the ultraviolet background), and releasing keeps the state reached — no cooling physics is invented |
| INT-AMOUNT-001 | set | an explicit setting: the notch maps linearly onto log10 N_HI over the domain; an arrow key moves it 0.01 dex | none — kept explicit on purpose. | INT-VPEC-001 | drag | the arrow's tip stays under the hand — 0.45 px per km/s; an arrow key moves it by 5 km/s | moving the gas's motion by hand is a way to explore other velocities; the toy's own velocities are restored with one quiet action, and a faint band shows the range it actually has |
| INT-PICK-001 | tap | the parcel whose gas is under the pointer is selected; dragging the gas changes nothing (its motion is its arrow's, INT-VPEC-001) | the gas is the object, the arrow its motion — in Beat 6 dragging the gas moves its place, so here it never means its velocity |

## Bounds, display choices and caches

- **INT-PROBE-001.** the probe is a place on the line of sight, not an object in the gas; the gas is continuous (no beads, no simulation particles)
- **INT-VIEW-001.** a depth cue only; the gas and the beam are unchanged
- **INT-ATOMV-001.** the shared push law (app/src/primitives/motion.js) at this beat's scale; the resonance window is drawn ~500× wider than natural (SCI-REP-004)
- **INT-TEMP-001.** every representation is recomputed from T in the same frame — no width or position is eased; the first-encounter formation (about 3.5 s, once per viewer) and the slow replay (about 9 s) only move marks between representations, landing at the exact v and b(T)
- **INT-THERM-BIN-001.** the atoms shown are exactly the representative sample's atoms whose v = g·σ(T) falls in the bin; each absorbs at its own Doppler offset (the natural width is ~2000× narrower), so the line's band is the bin's range, not a one-to-one map of colours to atoms
- **INT-LIGHT-001.** the reader controls position; redshift and every wavelength follow from it (z from the comoving distance, Planck 2018) — redshift is never the slider
- **INT-SQUEEZE-001.** a uniform compression about 0 Å that stops at the quasar's own frame (it cannot be squeezed further) and cannot stretch beyond ours
- **INT-PLACE-001.** the parcel is moved within the 4.4 Mpc/h teaching stretch; a real parcel elsewhere would have its own density, temperature and motion — here only the place changes, one variable at a time every frame recomputes the parcel's cells, its τ (lyaphys parcelTau) and the chained arrows from (x, v_pec, T, N_HI)
- **INT-PUSH-001.** the drag range exceeds the toy sightline's measured peculiar velocities ({{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_window_kms.0:.1f}} to {{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_window_kms.1:.1f}} km/s in this stretch; {{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_sightline_kms.0:.1f}} to {{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_sightline_kms.1:.1f}} km/s along the whole 20 Mpc/h toy sightline): values outside are a controlled teaching intervention, and the scene says so beside the arrow; the range is wide enough to reverse b and c the same instrument as Beat 7, one implementation (app/src/primitives/motion.js) — the same sign convention, scale, sandbox and measured range
- **INT-WARM-001.** the same law as Beat 3, one implementation (app/src/primitives/hold.js)
- **INT-AMOUNT-001.** set directly at fixed density, temperature and place (the microscope shows what sets it in nature); the range spans lines from unsaturated (τ₀ < 1) to strongly saturated
- **INT-VPEC-001.** the drag range exceeds the toy sightline's measured peculiar velocities ({{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_window_kms.0:.1f}} to {{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_window_kms.1:.1f}} km/s in this stretch; {{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_sightline_kms.0:.1f}} to {{VAL-TOY-001:vpec_sightline_kms.1:.1f}} km/s along the whole 20 Mpc/h toy sightline): values outside are a controlled teaching intervention, and the scene says so beside the arrow; the range is wide enough to reverse b and c the threads, the parcel's τ and the flux are recomputed from the state in every frame (τ memoised on its exact inputs — identical numbers); the first-encounter reveal grows the toy's velocities in as v = f·v_sim, every frame a physical state
- **INT-VSCAN-001.** emphasis uses each sub-cell's thermal-kernel optical depth at u — the Gaussian core of the Voigt profile the spectrum uses (for these columns the damping wings are negligible); several parcels can land at one colour; the scene lists every parcel carrying at least 5 % of the optical depth there (the share Beat 12 traces)
- **INT-INSPECT-001.** the lens composites its beam exactly as the ribbon (light·T + ink·(1 − T), T the product so far) and shows the five deepest layers plus the others summed; the ribbon and its glow are not changed by inspecting
- **INT-SCAN-001.** the decomposition is recomputed exactly at every cursor position — no interpolation or cache between colours, no snapping to clean examples; the gas stains ease in opacity only (about 0.15 s); threads linger 1.2 s after scanning stops, then fade (stills and reduced motion keep them faint)
- **INT-GASREGION-001.** the region's τ uses the same kernel and cut as the spectrum; its breadth is shown as it is (the colours where its τ exceeds 5 % of its peak are counted) tauFromCells memoised per region on its exact cells (identical numbers)
